data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 樱花树下的命名纪念
data.description: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字；「十香」这个被赋予的名字，是她与这个世界最初的契约。
data.action: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字
data.promptProse: Standing beneath a wide canopy of full-bloom sakura boughs on a clear spring afternoon, Tohka wears her crisp navy-jacket school uniform with ribbon tie and pleated skirt. She tilts her face gently upward with softly parted lips and a tender, wondering expression, quietly mouthing her own name as pale pink cherry petals drift past her shoulders. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the blossoms against the blue sky.
data.animaCaption: Standing beneath full-bloom cherry boughs in her navy school uniform, Tohka tilts her face upward with parted lips and a gentle smile as pink sakura petals drift around her. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through the flowering branches against the spring sky.
